name: hook-post-bodies
description: How a hook post's body is found. No Content-Length (and not chunked) is an empty body, answered at once; an unreadable or overflowing Content-Length counts as none. A chunked body (Transfer-Encoding matched in any case) is not decoded: it is read to the end of the stream and handed over whole, so real chunk framing makes it unreadable while a raw JSON body still reads; a Content-Length wins over chunked. A peer that closes before its declared length is answered with what came. Bytes past the declared length are ignored. Every one is answered 204; only a body that reads as a hook is delivered.
reason: Hook scripts and curl vary; whatever they send, the post is answered and never left hanging (HK-249, HK-251).
verifiedBy: DESIGN.md v1.4, v1.7, v2.15; docs/protocol.md spec v0. Rust: rust/powerup-core/tests/listener.rs listener_scenarios plays every step through protocol::listener::Listener. Swift: Tests/PowerUpTests/ListenerScenarioTests.swift testEveryListenerScenario plays every step through the bridge (CoreBridge.ListenerPolicy), and ProtocolServerTests drives the same policy over a real loopback socket.

steps.reason: Settings start the listener: the start stops first (generation 1), then binds 127.0.0.1 with generation 2 (RemoteListener.swift:79-135).
The bind is ready: running, no problem (RemoteListener.swift:158-161).
A socket is accepted: it becomes connection 1 under the 15-second deadline (RemoteListener.swift:222-257, 427-433).
No Content-Length: the body is empty and the request complete; an empty body is no hook (RemoteListener.swift:530-532, 761-764).
A socket is accepted: it becomes connection 2 under the 15-second deadline (RemoteListener.swift:222-257, 427-433).

bytes.text:
POST /event HTTP/1.1
X-PowerUp-Token: secret
Content-Length: abc

{"hook_event_name":"Stop","session_id":"s-1","cwd":"/Users/me/app","permission_mode":"default","last_assistant_message":"All tests pass."}

steps.reason: A Content-Length Int(String) cannot read counts as none: empty body, the bytes that follow are not read.
A socket is accepted: it becomes connection 3 under the 15-second deadline (RemoteListener.swift:222-257, 427-433).

POST /event HTTP/1.1
X-PowerUp-Token: secret
Transfer-Encoding: chunked

steps.reason: Chunked: the body is read to the end of the stream (RemoteListener.swift:527-529).
The chunks arrive: still waiting for the end of the stream.
The end of the stream: answered with the raw chunked bytes as the body, which read as no JSON, so nothing is delivered (RemoteListener.swift:495-498).
A socket is accepted: it becomes connection 4 under the 15-second deadline (RemoteListener.swift:222-257, 427-433).
Content-Length 40 but only 26 bytes: waiting for the rest.
The peer closes early: answered with the bytes that came, which are a whole Stop hook.
A socket is accepted: it becomes connection 5 under the 15-second deadline (RemoteListener.swift:222-257, 427-433).
Bytes past Content-Length are cut off, so the body reads.
A socket is accepted: it becomes connection 6 under the 15-second deadline (RemoteListener.swift:222-257, 427-433).
Int(String) reads a leading plus sign.
A socket is accepted: it becomes connection 7 under the 15-second deadline (RemoteListener.swift:222-257, 427-433).
Half a head.
The peer closes before the head ended: cancelled, unanswered.
A socket is accepted: it becomes connection 8 under the 15-second deadline (RemoteListener.swift:222-257, 427-433).

steps.reason: A Content-Length wins over chunked: the 26 bytes complete the request at once, with no wait for the end of the stream (RemoteListener.swift:521-530).
A socket is accepted: it becomes connection 9 under the 15-second deadline (RemoteListener.swift:222-257, 427-433).

bytes.text:
POST /event HTTP/1.1
X-PowerUp-Token: secret
Transfer-Encoding: chunked

{"hook_event_name":"Stop"}

steps.reason: Chunked with a body that is not chunk framing: still waiting for the end of the stream.
The end of the stream: everything after the head is the body, which here reads as a Stop hook and is delivered (RemoteListener.swift:495-498).
A socket is accepted: it becomes connection 10 under the 15-second deadline (RemoteListener.swift:222-257, 427-433).

bytes.text:
POST /event HTTP/1.1
X-PowerUp-Token: secret
Transfer-Encoding: CHUNKED

steps.reason: Chunked is found in any case: the request waits for the end of the stream instead of being answered with an empty body.
The end of the stream with no body: answered, nothing delivered.
A socket is accepted: it becomes connection 11 under the 15-second deadline (RemoteListener.swift:222-257, 427-433).
A Content-Length past Int's range is one Int(String) cannot read: it counts as none, so the body is empty and the request is answered at once with nothing delivered.
